No JdbcApprovalStore, JdbcAuthorizationCodeServices, or JdbcClientTokenServices is configured, so clientdetails/oauth_approvals/oauth_code/oauth_client_token have no persistence operation.
limitations: Runtime DB is MySQL 8.0.42 with default strict sql_mode (STRICT_TRANS_TABLES). The original deployment targets TiDB at tidb.funtl.com:4000, which was not available; enforcement under TiDB or a non-strict MySQL sql_mode may differ.

Only the POST /reg insert path (business-reg -> Dubbo -> provider-admin-service) was deployed. The profile update paths (POST /profile/update, /profile/modify/icon, /profile/modify/password) write the same table, but they need the OAuth2 resource server (business-oauth2 + Redis + extra HTTP port) and were not exercised.
